title: Serious Young Boy in Cardigan & Saddle Shoes, May 1950 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white full-length snapshot of a serious-looking young boy standing outside on the lawn next to a bush and the siding of a house. He is dressed in a piped cardigan jacket over a striped shirt, dark shorts, socks, and classic two-tone saddle shoes. The photograph features decorative scalloped deckle edges characteristic of post-WWII mid-century consumer film development.
